topic: MLOps and End-to-End AI Project Architecture
learningObjectives: Understand the lifecycle of a production machine learning system
Identify monitoring, versioning, and retraining components
Design an end-to-end architecture for an AI application

activities.title: MLOps Lifecycle Map
activities.instruction: Explore each stage of the machine learning lifecycle.

content.concept: MLOps connects development, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance throughout the ML lifecycle.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Collect and store data required by the ML system.
Clean, validate, transform, and prepare data for modeling.
Develop and experiment with machine learning solutions.
Train the model using prepared data and selected configurations.
Make the trained model available for real-world predictions.
Track system health, data quality, predictions, and model behavior.
Update the model using new data or improved configurations when needed.
